description: @PREV / @NEXT positional sibling navigators (CORE_MODEL_SPEC §3.2, §3.5, §3.7). Sibling order is the workspace node array order.

cases.name: @PREV.Name reads the previous sibling's child
cases.note: Under 2005 the order is [Q1, Q2, Total]; Q2's previous sibling is Q1.

cases.name: @NEXT.Name reads the next sibling's child
cases.note: Q1's next sibling is Q2; descend child Margin.

cases.name: @NEXT past the last sibling errors

expect.reason: #REF!: Total is the last child of 2005, so @NEXT is out of range

cases.note: @PREV/@NEXT are single refs that produce #REF! on out-of-range (§3.5 family table).
